'''Anastasia''' is a female NPC who appears in {{location|Fool's Elysium|nocat=1}}. She rescued [[Federico]] and [[Chantelle]] from the [[Pilgrim's Sail]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:;'''Federico:''' Who... who are you? How did you suddenly appear at sea? Why are you rescuing us?
:;'''Federico:''' I just want to return to [[Ragunna City]]… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
:;'''Chantelle:''' Fede... we can't go back.
:;'''Anastasia:''' I understand your panic, Mr. Fede. But remember this—
:;'''Anastasia:''' In the eyes of [[Order of the Deep|The Order]], a pilgrimage is no different from an execution...
:'''Federico:''' Is there really no hope? If we head to [[Lilyland]] or [[Septimont]]... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
:'''Anastasia:''' I... I don't know...
:'''Chantelle:''' Wake up, Fid. No city-state will take in outcasts without identity, unable to prove their very existence. We've lost our status as citizens of Ragunna.
:'''Chantelle:''' Even our papers... they've turned to nothing but scraps of useless parchment.
:'''Federico:''' Is there really no one who'll take us in? I still have a few friends... I...
:'''Chantelle:''' Your friends? Do you truly think they'd welcome "heretics" like us?
:'''Federico:''' What would you have me do, Chantelle? The Order's just left us to die out here, haven't they? How could they do this to us...?
:'''Anastasia:''' Mr. Federico, please... stay calm. You can stay here while you plan your next steps.
:'''Chantelle:''' Thank you so much Ahem... Fid?
:'''Federico:''' Y-yes, thank you. I... we don't know how to thank you enough...
----
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:{{Spoiler}}
:;'''Federico:''' So, can we go back to Ragunna now? My property, my family... They might still be there.
:;'''Chantelle:''' Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is... unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
:;'''Federico:''' I don't care! I'm going back now!
:;'''Anastasia:''' Mr. Fede, the Order's silence in times like these is anything but normal. For your own safety, please don't act on impulse.
:'''Federico:''' I heard something big has happened in Ragunna... If we return now, maybe we can find our place again.
:'''Chantelle:''' ...Though our status as citizens has been erased, if our acquaintances are willing to vouch for us, we might actually have a chance.
:'''Federico:''' I've already sent letters to the friends who still live there. Perhaps hope is finally within reach...
:'''Chantelle:''' Me too! I want to reach out to my friends! I'd do anything just to return to my homeland.
:'''Chantelle:''' This time, I'll follow the Order's rules strictly and live a simple life.
:'''Federico:''' O Sentinel above... Wait, can we still say that?
:'''Anastasia:''' Are you...
:'''Federico:''' No, no, no, we're not complaining that this place isn't good enough. Please, don't misunderstand.
:'''Anastasia:''' It's alright. I understand. Missing home is only natural. I miss mine too.
:'''Chantelle:''' But... should I really go home? Miss Anastasia and everyone here mean so much to me...
:'''Anastasia:''' If you want, you can always stay here.
:'''Chantelle:''' That would be wonderful...
{{Dialogue End}}
